editorial:
Imagine being a doctor who thinks they can fix the worst kind of monster. You follow Diana Purlow, a prison psychologist who is convinced she can find the root of a serial killer's madness. The warden tells her to stay away and warns her that it is a bad idea, but she does not listen. She dives deep into the mind of Jesse Mowat, and the vibe quickly shifts from a professional medical study to a total nightmare. You will feel the tension grow as the line between the doctor and the patient starts to blur in a very scary way.

The acting is solid, and the way the movie plays with your head is the best part. While the pacing starts a bit slow, the twists at the end make the wait worth it. If you enjoy stories where a smart person gets in over their head, you will love this. You can find it for rent on Apple TV if you want a quick watch, but if you are a horror fan, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: You find out that Jesse Mowat is not just a regular killer. He has a psychic ability to pull people into his own mental world. Diana gets trapped inside his mind, and the twist is that he successfully swaps places with her. He escapes the prison in her body, leaving the real Diana stuck in a mental prison. It ends with the killer winning and walking free while the doctor is left screaming in silence.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mind-bending horror and twisted endings.
